baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural active participle at word 1, the alayhi construction, and al-hamim at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Liquid intake is presented as an ongoing role, while alayhi makes that intake supervene upon an antecedent rather than stand as an isolated sip.

activation_trace.role: Liquid intake supplies the concrete act and the participle casts the subjects as engaged drinkers.
Hot water supplies the thermal object that makes the ongoing intake harmful rather than relieving.

changed_reading.after: They enter an ongoing act of taking in hot liquid as a consequent layer upon something already undergone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Sharibuna and min al-hamim at 56:54, especially the bounded source phrase and plural role noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The drinking root can mark both a known water-share and water accepted despite aversion; the heat root can mark an affair whose time has arrived. Together they permit an apportioned, unavoidable draught rather than voluntary refreshment.

activation_trace.role: A known share of water turns the drink into an allotted portion within the mechanism.
Water drunk despite salinity, bitterness, or aversion supplies coerced acceptability rather than desire.
An affair drawing near and becoming due gives the allotted draught a sense of unavoidable arrival.

changed_reading.before: The drink is a freely taken response to thirst.
changed_reading.after: The line can stage receipt of a due, measured, and aversive portion that cannot be declined.

context_deltas.mechanism: The drink becomes the internal completion of a surrounding regime: collective placement, enveloping side, penetrating hot wind, black smoke presented as shadow, and explicit withdrawal of coolness and generosity leave no exterior refuge and then carry the same condition inside the body.

activation_trace.role: Concrete liquid intake moves the surrounding condition from environment into the drinker.
Hot water makes the inward intake continuous with the thermal environment.
Companionship and abiding together make the exposed subjects a collective condition, not isolated sufferers.
Envelopment from multiple sides activates a spatial frame of comprehensive exposure.
A penetrating hot wind supplies an invasive exterior heat that the drink later internalizes.
Blackness, smoke, and char turn the nominal shadow into a continuation of burning rather than shelter.
Shade normally supplies covering shelter, whose failure here sharpens the removal of refuge.
Rest and settling after heat or motion are explicitly negated, blocking thermal recovery.
Honorable generosity is explicitly negated, blocking any hospitable reading of the offered liquid.

structural_cues: 56:41-44 moves from class designation to hot wind and hot water, then smoke-shadow, then the paired negation of coolness and generosity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, penetrating heat, failed shade, and negated relief; I infer that drinking transfers the same regime inward. A live alternative is simple accumulation of separate punishments without an exterior-to-interior arrow.

changed_reading.before: The hot drink is one discrete punishment among others.
changed_reading.after: It is the inward phase of a total enclosure in which heat occupies environment, shelter, and finally bodily intake.

context_deltas.mechanism: Former plenty released its possessors into excess, while repeated insistence bound them to grave breach; the later alayhi construction makes the aversive drink read as a returned persistence, where chosen attachment becomes compelled continuation.

activation_trace.role: Reluctantly drinkable water supplies the reversal from chosen indulgence to compelled intake.
Expansive ease that releases its possessor supplies the earlier condition of unrestrained consumption.
Tightening and binding turn their prior persistence into an attachment that can return as compulsion.
Insistence and resolve supply the durative pattern mirrored by their continuing role as drinkers.
Sin and constraining culpability identify what their chosen persistence had fastened upon.

structural_cues: The sequence contrasts former mutraf status in 56:45 with persistence ala al-hinth in 56:46, then uses alayhi again for the drinking in 56:54.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies released luxury, binding insistence, culpability, and the repeated ala construction; I infer a reciprocal reversal from self-chosen persistence to imposed persistence. The alternative is that the two prepositional constructions are locally independent.

changed_reading.before: They receive an externally imposed hot portion.
changed_reading.after: Their drinking also reenacts persistence in reversed agency: attachment once chosen under ease returns as an intake they must continue.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch of drinking denotes understanding, while the context supplies voiced doctrine, denial, and the stirring of the dead. Their refusal to take resurrection inward as belief is answered by literal inward intake after resurrection.

activation_trace.role: Drinking as understanding supplies the cognitive register that can be reversed into bodily reception.
Literal liquid intake materializes the understanding they had refused.
Saying as belief or doctrine makes their resurrection question an adopted stance, not mere sound.
Stirring the inert from rest supplies the very return their stated position resisted.
Contradiction of truth names the failed reception that precedes forced material reception.

structural_cues: 56:47 voices the resurrection challenge; 56:51 addresses the speakers as deniers; 56:52-55 replaces their speech with a chain of eating and drinking participles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies doctrinal speech, denial, revival, and a drinking-as-understanding branch; I infer an epistemic-to-somatic reversal. The live alternative is that the cognitive and liquid senses remain unrelated lexical branches.

changed_reading.before: The line depicts only bodily punishment after resurrection.
changed_reading.after: It can also function as an embodied counter-argument: what they would not receive as understanding is made into literal intake once they are raised.

context_deltas.mechanism: Revival, gathering, and a known appointment activate the focus roots as a due event and a measured water-share, recasting the draught as collectively administered at a fixed terminus.

activation_trace.role: A known water-share supplies the administered portion received by each gathered drinker.
The nearness and arrival of an affair align the hot draught with a due event.
Rousing what was still supplies the transition that makes bodily receipt possible.
Joining the dispersed into one collected body supplies the scale of administration.
A fixed appointment supplies the temporal boundary at which the due portion is delivered.
Known disclosure removes temporal indeterminacy from the appointment.

structural_cues: 56:47-50 moves from denial of revival to the gathering of earlier and later people at a known appointment before the ingestion sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revival, collection, fixed time, and focus branches of share and due arrival; I infer judicial administration of a ration. The alternative is a broad chronological frame with no distributive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: An individual happens upon a punishing drink.
changed_reading.after: A gathered population receives a due and apportioned draught at an already fixed appointment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Eating becomes swallowing, swallowing reaches vessel-equivalent fullness, yet fullness generates another intake whose comparison is thirst that cannot be quenched. The drink is therefore the second stage of a self-amplifying ingestion cycle, not its remedy.

activation_trace.role: Liquid intake supplies the second material stage after eating and filling.
Hot water prevents the second stage from functioning as ordinary cooling relief.
Taking food supplies the first ingestion stage to which alayhi points back.
Swallowing and gulping sharpen the first stage as forced passage rather than nourishment.
Fullness matching a container turns the belly into a vessel brought to capacity.
Bodily fullness or abdominal disorder makes capacity coexist with distress rather than satisfaction.
Repeated liquid-intake wording extends the act beyond a single compensating sip.
Severe thirst that is not quenched converts repeated drinking into endless demand.

structural_cues: The consecutive fa-marked sequence is eat in 56:52, fill bellies in 56:53, drink upon it in 56:54, and drink like al-him in 56:55.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered ingestion, container-fullness, repeated drinking, and unquenched thirst; I infer a feedback arrow in which fullness fails and drives further intake. The alternative is a serial punishment with no physiological causation.

changed_reading.before: Hot water follows food as a possible response to thirst.
changed_reading.after: The drink is an anti-remedy inside a cycle where maximal fullness produces, rather than resolves, unbounded thirst and further drinking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deictic summary classifies the preceding ingestion as nuzul, prepared provision for an arrival, while din classifies the day as reckoning and recompense. The aversive share thus becomes an inverted reception allocated to its recipients.

activation_trace.role: A known water-share supplies the portion assigned within the prepared reception.
Hot water makes the prepared provision an inversion of welcome and refreshment.
Provision prepared for one who arrives supplies the reception frame that gathers the preceding food and drink.
The day's grave event fixes the reception within a consequential occasion.
Accounting and recompense turn prepared provision into a measured return for prior conduct.

structural_cues: The demonstrative hadha in 56:56 points back to the eat-fill-drink sequence and predicates it as their nuzul on the day of din.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prepared provision, backward deixis, and recompense; I infer an ironic reversal of hospitality because the provision harms its recipients. The alternative is non-ironic nuzul meaning only a prepared allotment.

changed_reading.before: The hot drink is an unclassified affliction.
changed_reading.after: It is part of a deliberately prepared reception whose hospitality form has been reversed into exact recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-connects a fire-feeding eating branch, penetrating poison, absorbed mixture, and melted fat. It remains anchored in the focus's hot liquid and in the immediately antecedent eating and belly-filling sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for internalization, not as a replacement lexical sense of hamim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The liquid-intake root at word 1, alayhi, and the heat root at word 4 permit the antecedent material to be carried inward and transformed.

activation_trace.role: Absorbing water, dye, or love into a thing supplies permeation as the inward transport mechanism.
Melted fat supplies a material consequence of heat operating within what has been ingested.
Poison entering the body supplies a cross-domain image of invasive penetration.
Feeding a fire until it ignites lets the prior eating stage function analogically as fuel.
The belly as an interior supplies the bounded chamber in which the material analogy operates.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the hot drink completes an internal fuel-and-melting circuit in which punishment is absorbed into bodily material.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends plural morphology through the drinking-company and companionship branches into a social reading. It remains anchored in plural sharibuna, the named companions in 56:41, and repeated collective drinking in 56:55. Downstream prose should qualify it as social texture, not claim a formal communal rite.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural drinker noun at word 1 can denote not only repeated individuals but a constituted company of drinkers.

activation_trace.role: A company defined by drinking supplies a social identity inside the plural participle.
Companionship and abiding together supply the collective frame into which the drinkers are placed.
A company gathered after dispersal supplies cohesion, here activated darkly rather than positively.
The repeated plural drinking occurrence reinforces a group constituted by the same imposed act.

changed_reading.before: Many separate people undergo the same drink.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, compulsory drinking consolidates them into an inverted fellowship whose shared intake enacts their class identity.

strongest_changes: The eat-fill-drink-drink sequence turns the focus into an anti-satiation mechanism in which fullness generates unquenched further intake.
Former released luxury and chosen persistence, sharpened by the repeated ala construction, return as compelled persistence in an aversive act.
The closing hadha nuzuluhum yawma al-din recodes the drink as prepared, apportioned reception within recompense.
summary.what_was_special: With only drinking and heat roots, the focus remains unusually mobile: shares, reluctant water, drinking-company, bodily channels, absorption, and understanding combine with heat, due arrival, melting, and decree to let context shift one act across bodily, temporal, social, epistemic, and juridical mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent and force of alayhi may support sequence more securely than causation.
The understanding, drinking-company, permeation, and melting branches may be productive activations without being intended lexical senses here.
The appointment context may activate the due-arrival branch of hamim only analogically, so the administrative-ration model remains below strong confidence.
